serve.description: Serves the given directory on the specified port.

nudge.description: Simulates user activity (mouse movement, key press, scrolling) to keep your presence status active.

typeit.description: Simulates typing clipboard text (or custom string) into active window after countdown.

jwt.description: Inspect and decode JSON Web Tokens (JWT) safely off-line.

killport.description: Find and terminate processes listening on specified network ports.

hash.description: Compute and verify cryptographic checksums for files or text input.

fetch.description: Multithreaded download utility with automatic checksum capability.

reach.description: Network diagnostic CLI utility to test TCP reachability and inspect TLS certs.

slowfetch.description: Terminal system information fetcher powered by OSHI.

install-native.description: Compile and export catalog tools as standalone zero-overhead native executables.
